findings: The first-maximum tie rule is still current. std::max_element returns the first greatest element, so a later equal element is not chosen, and an empty range returns last. NumPy 2.5 argmax and the Array API 2025.12 return the index of the first occurrence of the maximum. The Array API raises for an invalid axis, not for an unknown detection-selection strategy.

Isaac ROS FoundationPose still builds the stage-2 mask from the highest-scoring detection in a Detection2DArray. Detection2DArrayFilter on main keeps a class-matched detection only when hypothesis.score is strictly greater than the running maximum, so a tie keeps the earlier detection, and it publishes that one Detection2D. A maximum that stays 0 returns without publishing. The filter does not take a caller count, does not keep the array slot, and does not return the detections it did not publish.

Current forklift pose still estimates one selected pallet. Lang2Lift (arXiv:2508.15427v2) selects the SAM-2 mask with the highest quality score and calls FoundationPose once on M_best. The YOLO26n pallet-pose deployment takes np.argmax of box confidence, states one pallet per frame, and leaves multi-pallet scenes untested. Neither result carries the other candidates source indices.

Current ifm getPallet still returns every localized pallet, up to 10, on the result the vehicle reads, ordered by palletOrder. The default is scoreDescending. palletIndex is a template type 0-9, not a Detection2DArray slot. PalletDetection is a header plus pocket poses and has no source_index and no deferred list. That reorder is the full result list, not an admitted prefix plus a deferred remainder in candidate order.

Current messages still identify one capture by header stamps and still have no admission vectors. Detection2DArray is an ordered list of proposals from one input. Detection2D.id may be empty and is a cross-message id, not the array slot. Rolling message_filters ExactTime requires the same header stamp, and ApproximateTime matches those stamps without requiring them to be equal. PoseStamped is a header plus a pose. Detection3D has no deferred-index field. DiagnosticStatus values are KeyValue strings. No current source found writes the admitted source index and the order-preserving deferred source indices on the pose the handling process reads and repeats those two lists on the failure diagnostic.
